segments.text:
V. 9.
But the wiſe anſwered, Leſt there be not enough for us and you? —Beginning the Sentence with a beautiful Abr•peneſs; ſuch as ſhewed their Surpriſe at the State of thoſe poor Wretches, who had ſo long deceived them, as well as their own Souls. Leſt there be not enough—It is ſure there is not; for no Man has more than Holineſs enough for himſelf. Go ye rather to them that ſell—Without Money and without Price: That is, to GOD, to Chriſt. And buy—If ye can. O no! The Time is paſt, and returns no more!
